# Money Printer Go BRRR

Since 1971, money printers have gone BRRR. This is a living collection of data-led notebooks for following the forces behind rates, risk, growth, and liquidity.

[Start with the release calendar](Chapters/00_ReleaseCalendar/1_ReleaseCalendar.Rmd){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg}
[View the source](https://github.com/ckrusemd/money-printer-go-brrr){.btn .btn-outline-light .btn-lg}
:::

## The notebook

Each chapter is rendered from the analysis notebook that produces its charts and tables. The published book hides implementation code so the emphasis stays on the findings, while the source remains available from every page.

## Sources and cadence

The analysis draws primarily on [FRED](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/), [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/), [Statistics Denmark](https://www.dst.dk/), and [Finans Danmark](https://finansdanmark.dk/). The site is refreshed daily; market data may reflect the most recent trading day.
